why: SEC-DETECTORS D1 (SECURITY-HARDENING-AUDIT, operator ask 2026-11-11 ~21:55Z for alerts on suspicious activity). Adds scripts/ops/security_watch.py and a 5-min oneshot timer on the live VM that sends one red-flag ping for an SSH login with an identity outside the recorded baseline, a failed-login burst, or an unreadable journal. Reads only: no gate, no halt, nothing blocked. Tier 2 because the installer enables the new timer on the next deploy and the diag unit allowlist (web-api) gains two names.
hold_text: Tier-2: manager merges. The deploy installs and starts ict-security-watch.timer.
